```yaml
name: Agentics Maintenance

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'  # daily check

jobs:
  check-duplication:
    name: Verify latestVersions logic consistency
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Compare latestVersions implementations
        shell: bash
        run: |
          FILE1="build-tools/packages/build-cli/src/commands/check/latestVersions.ts"
          FILE2="build-tools/packages/build-cli/src/commands/vnext/check/latestVersions.ts"
          echo "Comparing $FILE1 and $FILE2 for identical logic..."
          diff -q "$FILE1" "$FILE2" || (echo "❌ Duplicate code mismatch detected between $FILE1 and $FILE2. Please ensure both files contain identical logic." && exit 1)
          echo "✅ Duplicate code check passed – both files are identical."
```
